leave_personal_days_004.evidence: One (1) day of leave with pay each year is granted to an educator for personal matters which require the educator's absence during school hours.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Requires at least three (3) school days' notice except in emergencies; not subject to principal approval.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: Except in emergency situations, the educator shall give at least three (3) school days' notice to the principal that leave will be taken under this section. ... (Not subject to approval of the principal)
